buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 2. Generic Bidders shall quote only those products (Part of Service delivery) in the bid which are not obsolete in the market and has at least 2 years residual market life i.e. the offered product shall not be declared end-of- life by the OEM before this period. 3. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 4. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 5. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 6. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification.

7. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Seller to upload all the documents on their letter pads. In case any information is endorsed on a plain pape r it needs to be stamped/sign ed by the seller, failing which bidder will be liable for rejection during Techni cal evaluation. Catalogue of offered product must be attached along with bid documents. Any seller uploaded document f ound to be violating the above mentioned clause will not be considered authentic for consideration in tech nical bid and will be liable to be rejected. Item required on urgent basis. Seller to dispatch item on priority through a fast and trackable courier servi ce.The details of dispatch such as challan, receipt and tracking id to be shared by the seller with buyer on priority. Failure to share the tracking details may lead to reporting of incident against seller under the category of ' Failed to share required information'. All firms to self-certify that a minimum of 20% indigenous content is there in the offered product. The cost components for installation, transportation and insurance will not be included in this 20% bracket. False certification will invite action as per laid down procedure. Seller should be responsible for collection o f items if found any unsuitable from buyer premises. Note: All bidders are to provide acceptance of buyer technical specification document a nd buyer added ATC attached in bid with signature and firm seal. Acceptance of the same has to be acknowledged separately on letter head with firm seal. Failur e to do the same will lead to disqualification. ITEM REQUIRED ONLY AS PER ATTACHED TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION ONLY. If a firm fails to respond to clarifications sought by the buyer during technical evaluation, no representatio n from the firm is to be entertained on disqualification . 8.
